mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.doc_id, f.item_id, f.receipt_id, r.receipt_no, f.material_id, f.diff_type, f.qty, f.serial_nos, f.remark, f.resolution, f.resolve_date, f.resolve_by, ru.nickname AS resolve_by_name, f.resolve_time, f.resolve_remark, f.ref_doc_id, rd.doc_no AS ref_doc_no, rd.kind AS ref_doc_kind, f.create_by, cu.nickname AS create_by_name, f.create_time, f.update_time, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.serial_enabled, i.batch_no FROM wms_transfer_diff f JOIN wms_stock_doc_item i ON i.id = f.item_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = f.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_transfer_receipt r ON r.id = f.receipt_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc rd ON rd.id = f.ref_doc_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = f.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = f.resolve_by WHERE f.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY f.id
